verdict.rationale: The docs say you can connect your computer once to make its local files, code, and apps available to your dot, and that the dot can create and continue local Work or Codex tasks and run builds with permitted local repositories and developer tools. The dot also has its own cloud computer and browser, which you can watch and take over and then return control. Rules and app permissions govern what it may do. Missing for 10: detail on how the dot actually sees and operates local desktop application interfaces (local work appears to run through delegated Work/Codex tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
